phoneAndCourier: Phone substitutions are number literals. Courier order joins LocalizeItem output with count suffix (x{0}); Serbian introducers retain colon-separated labels. Priest alternatives are individual RunLine instructions under the saved branch labels, not assumed concatenated sentences.
limitations: Some same-place candidate enum keys (Twins, Neighbour, Alkonost) have no source UI label. No label or runtime reachability is invented. Managed reference registry excluded from header-verified config field extraction; no complete serialized object validation claimed.
